summary: Core history and the CURRENT FACTS items (2025-26 record, LaMelo trade, Cup Group C, Feb 15 game, no opener or Christmas game) are consistent across the dossiers. The errors found were mostly stale or garbled details: the CIAA Tournament treated as still in Charlotte (it left after 2020) in three retail and rhythm files, Jordan Brand dated to 2014 instead of 2017, honeycomb placed in the 1988-2002 era, Bobby Jones assigned to South Mecklenburg, Luke Combs's upbringing, Hive dates, Dell Curry's broadcaster role and a miscounted set of home Cup nights. All were fixed in place. Three live checks: Black Sheep Skate Shop exists (location unconfirmed), SC's tax-free weekend is real (Aug 7-9, 2026) and Brooks' Sandwich House is open but its land is for sale. The remaining risk is small-business and venue status, player shoe deals (Brandon Miller and Puma, Steph Curry), the City Edition and arena name, and the Duke-UNC and festival dates strategy.json builds on; the strategy brief needs the Cup-night count, Puma and Black Sheep wording fixed by the editor.
